message.reasoning:
The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can launch the application. The user might want to start Docker engine via command line. We can provide a command: `net start com.docker.service`. Or using PowerShell: `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can start it via `& "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`. But the user explicitly says "using docker start". That is wrong usage. We should explain that docker start starts containers, not the Docker daemon. So we can give correct command: `net start com.docker.service`. Then we can call the function to execute that command.
